finding_key: packages/docs/src/model/color.ts::`resolvestoredcolor` only collapses the bare `''` before the resolver, so the `{ kind: 'srgb', value: '' }` form the docstring calls reachable lands on the docs default instead of the theme color
evidence: packages/docs/src/model/color.ts: `resolveStoredColor` is `resolve(c === '' ? undefined : c) || undefined`, so only the bare string '' is normalized before the resolver; `{ kind: 'srgb', value: '' }` reaches the resolver intact, resolves to '' (defaultColorResolver returns c.value verbatim), and is only dropped after — meaning callers fall back to theme.defaultColor rather than a theme-aware resolver's "no color set" branch. The PR's own docstring says normalizing only after would "paint near-black text on a dark deck", and its own slides test declares the object form a reachable #728 shape, so the asymmetry is a real gap by the PR's own model. Confidence is medium because slides' makeColorResolver and the theme object slides passes to renderRun were not readable in this environment, so I could not confirm the dark-deck consequence end-to-end.
